title: A category keeps every Edit Category field, each saving as today
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Use a client connected to QuickBooks.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, with Tax Exempt off.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Tick Tax Exempt.
  4. Pick an item in QuickBooks Products and Services.
  5. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page shows its name, QuickBooks Products and Services and Tax Exempt, the fields of today's Edit Category.

Step 3:

  • Tax Exempt is ticked.

Step 4:

  • The picked item shows.

Step 5:

  • After the reload Tax Exempt is still ticked and the QuickBooks item is still picked.
